capabilities: create a Things project from the current note
create a Things task in the Inbox from the current line
add deeplinks between the note and the Things item for navigation
extras: The README says the project is currently unsupported and points to a supported fork, but the fork is not named (the link was stripped from the text).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send tasks or projects to the Things app or navigate between a note and the corresponding Things item.
summary: Integration with the Things app that creates Things tasks and projects from notes and links them with deeplinks.
